title: Decision records, contracts and playbooks
story: As every team I need fixed decisions (harness, layout, defaults, delegation controls, demo architecture, meeting format, evidence policy), data contracts and role prompts so I can build without waiting on others
acceptance: ADR-000..006 exist with status, owner, date and a decision
ADR-003 defines decision rights, authority limits, separation of duties, content vetoes, tool policy, gates, budget controls, escalation and audit trail
ADR-005 agenda sums to 40 minutes with time checkpoints and a cut list
Four contract schemas exist and the contracts README assigns claim id ranges with no overlaps
teams.json defines nine teams each with director, manager, IC roles and disjoint owned folders

verdicts.reason: All 5 criteria met: ADR-000..006 with status/owner/date/decision; ADR-003 has all 9 control sections; agenda sums to 40 with checkpoints+cut list; 12 non-overlapping CLM ranges and 4 schemas; 9 teams with disjoint owns; nits only
